card.name: Small words in the middle of descriptive phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words, punctuation or a blank space right before a descriptive detail or number, in technical descriptions such as botanical keys, anatomy, symptoms and specifications.

modes.label: Linking word before a qualifier
modes.description: A preposition or conjunction such as with, or, to or on that comes before the next descriptive term.
modes.example: SDHC readers are backwards compatible<< with>> SD cards

modes.label: Space or bracket before a number or gloss
modes.description: A blank space before a number or an opening bracket or quote that begins a gloss.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of fluconazole for vaginal candidiasis is<< >>150 mg as a single oral

modes.label: Modifier inside a list of findings
modes.description: An adjective or adverb inside a list of anatomical or malformation features.

card.writes: It slightly favors seat-related tokens and disfavors opening-related tokens, so the output effect is weak and unclear.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words just before a descriptive detail, with no single topic.
